diagnosis.overall_diagnosis: The location hint points to gaps/ambiguities in the core guidance (SKILL.md) around (1) making chart elements reliably clickable, (2) ensuring text labels overlay bubbles without blocking pointer events, and (3) defining/verifying bidirectional linking between chart and table for acceptance. The reusable guidance should be tightened to avoid common D3 pitfalls (text intercepting clicks, inconsistent selection keys, lack of deterministic highlight state) that would cause evaluation failures for this task.

diagnosed_skills.diagnosis: The skill documentation likely provides incomplete or incorrect guidance in the sections about clickable graphics, text overlay layers, and bidirectional (chart<->table) linkage acceptance. In this task, bubble labels (text) often sit above circles and can capture pointer events, preventing circle hover/click tooltips and selection; additionally, without explicit keyed joins and a shared selection state, chart/table highlighting can desync or be non-deterministic. The acceptance/verification checklist for two-way linking is probably underspecified.
diagnosed_skills.repair_instruction: Update the referenced sections to include concrete, deterministic implementation guidance: (1) make the clickable target a parent <g> per datum and attach events to that group (or set text pointer-events:none) so labels don't block hover/click; (2) ensure label overlay ordering (append circle then text) and explicitly set CSS/SVG attributes to keep text visible while not intercepting events; (3) prescribe a single source of truth for selection (selectedTicker), keyed data joins for both bubbles and table rows, and functions like setSelected(ticker) that update both views; (4) add an explicit acceptance checklist for bidirectional linking (click bubble highlights row + scroll into view; click row highlights bubble; repeated clicks toggle/replace selection; stable keys by ticker; deterministic rendering). Preserve unrelated guidance.
